about: INDICATOR HOUSE'S COPY AND INSPECT-A-BAR IN THE DOOR'S WORKER (feat/pine-door-paths, stacked on the saved-script upgrade and #2254): each path asks the member door's worker for one build and never runs the door on the page's main thread; every build is released once read.

mutants.mutant: Indicator House's copy builds on the main thread again
mutants.from: const landed = await doorBuildOnce({ source: item.pine, id, name: item.name })
mutants.to: const landed = { built: (await import('./builder/memberPane/memberPaneDefinition')).memberPaneDefinition({ source: item.pine, id, name: item.name }) }
mutants.expectRed: door calls on the MAIN thread for the copy

mutants.mutant: inspect-a-bar builds the script and its probe copies on the main thread again
mutants.from: const landed = await doorBuildOnce({ source, id: MEMBER_PANE_DEF_PREFIX })
mutants.to: const landed = { built: (await import('../memberPane/memberPaneDefinition')).memberPaneDefinition({ source, id: MEMBER_PANE_DEF_PREFIX }) }
mutants.expectRed: door calls on the MAIN thread for the inspection

mutants.mutant: a one-shot build is never released (the service holds every answer)
